entrypoints.summary: The solver sends service request 629 with a caller-selected nodeId, including npc://System/Marvin/DefaultSeed, and attributeId 13 (Value).
NodeManager parses npc URIs and dispatches any URI whose host is system to SystemNode.Find.
The solver submits a data/signature pair in service request 632 nodesToImport.

affected_components.role: Maps a remote system URI into Assembly.Load, GetType, GetProperty, and GetValue.
Verifies an imported signed string, unpickles it to System.Object, and invokes callable output.
Documents the intended protocol sequence from seed read through signed import.

code_slices.surrounding_context: NodeManager dispatches npc system hosts to SystemNode, while the solver reads DefaultSeed and later posts a signed serialized payload.
code_slices.vulnerable: SystemNode derives System.Private.CoreLib/System.<path> from URI path and reflects a static property; the signed import path verifies supplied text, unpickles it as System.Object, and calls an FSharpFunc<Unit,unit>.

mitigations.concept: allowlisted node/property access and non-executable typed signed payloads

relation_candidates.rationale: The client-selected system URI is dispatched to SystemNode, which resolves a reflection-derived property value.
The solver reads DefaultSeed and uses the parsed seed as the collision finder input.

The solver's stated workflow uses colliding signed values, calls an external recover_key helper, then signs and imports the serialized payload; the exact crypto relation cannot be checked without crypto.nautilus and recover_key.py.
The import handler verifies the supplied signature, unpickles the signed data, and directly invokes a resulting FSharpFunc<Unit,unit>.
The solver's final payload is a serialized function instance whose pubkeypath is /flag.txt.

relation_candidates.dst: allowlisted node/property access and non-executable typed signed payloads
relation_candidates.rationale: Eliminating generic unpickling/callable invocation and restricting exposed nodes removes the documented reflection and executable-object paths.

impact.affected_asset: Server process execution boundary and the challenge's /flag.txt secret.
impact.attacker_capability: A remote protocol client can read a runtime-internal static property through the system URI route and, contingent on the solver's unresolved collision/key-recovery chain, submit a signed serialized executable object for invocation.
impact.security_effect: Potential server-side execution of a deserialized F# function after a forged accepted signed object; the supplied solver targets a function payload configured to access /flag.txt.

causal_trace.summary: A remote protocol client supplies an npc://System/Marvin/DefaultSeed node identifier in a read request.
The router treats every npc URI with host system as a SystemNode; SystemNode constructs a System.Private.CoreLib/System.<path> reflection path and reads its static property without an allowlist.

The official solver parses the disclosed seed, constructs a seeded hash collision for chosen UTF-16 data, obtains signatures for two values, and invokes a separate key-recovery helper; the server's embedded comment describes this collision/signature-to-private-key chain. The crypto.nautilus implementation is not included, so the precise cryptographic relation remains unverified here.

On a valid signature, the import handler unpickles attacker-provided text as System.Object and invokes it when it is an FSharpFunc<Unit,unit>. The solver builds a serialized payload configured with /flag.txt, signs it using its recovered private key workflow, and submits it for import.

failure.operation: Reflection-backed SystemNode property read followed by verified generic-object unpickling and FSharpFunc invocation

primary_invariant.statement: Remote node reads must be confined to an approved node/property set, and signature acceptance must not authorize deserialization and invocation of an attacker-selected executable object.
primary_invariant.violated_because: A system-host URI reaches reflection-derived runtime properties, exposing DefaultSeed; the server then accepts validly signed text, FsPickler-unpickles it as a generic object, and executes an FSharpFunc result.

quality.review_notes: Organizer source and an official solver establish the routing, reflection, signature-verification, unpickling, and intended payload workflow. No successful execution transcript is supplied; the flag artifact is redacted. crypto.nautilus, including the precise collision-to-key-recovery condition, is absent, and the Docker runtime is stated to approximate production.

remediation.invariant_restored: Only explicitly authorized non-sensitive nodes are remotely readable, while signed inputs are canonical typed data that cannot deserialize into or invoke executable objects.
mitigation_classes: allowlist node identifiers and runtime properties
do not expose process hash seeds
verify signatures over canonical collision-resistant payload bytes
avoid generic deserialization and callable-object invocation for remotely supplied content

affected_versions_or_commits.value: .NET 6.0.412; supplied Docker environment is explicitly an approximation
